title: 1.3 Blueprint Reconstruction
concept: Rebuilding a binary tree from Preorder + Inorder
objective: Rebuild from Pre {10,5,2,7,15,12,20} & In {2,5,7,10,12,15,20}, then click the reconstructed root!
controls: Click [Reconstruct Pre+In] -> Click reconstructed root node (10)
start_status: Blueprint shredded! Click [Reconstruct Pre+In [R]], then click the reconstructed root!
hints: The first Preorder value is always the root. Press Reconstruct to rebuild the tree.
The root of the rebuilt tree is the first value of the Preorder list.
